title: Graduate Development Program (TikTok Shop E-commerce, Malaysia) - 2027 Start

deadline.evidence: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

application_cap.evidence: Candidates can apply to a maximum of two positions and will be considered for jobs in the order you apply.

materials_required.evidence: Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

degree_requirement.evidence: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor's degree in any field or a related discipline.

responsibilities: Rotate across core TikTok Shop e-commerce functions
Support business growth initiatives across seller acquisition, seller incubation, creator partnerships, campaign management, platform operations, and business intelligence
Analyze business performance and identify key insights
Build scalable playbooks and operating mechanisms
Communicate findings and recommendations to managers and business leaders
